subject: Finalizing Commit Tranches & Onramp Incentives for Nimbus PoV
messages:
From: Jared Lin <jared@nimhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff — MAP & onramp pricing

Kimberly,

Thanks for the call earlier. The exec team liked the MAP approach but wants clarity on the commit tranches and how discounts kick in over the onramp. Two specific asks from my side:

- Can you lay out a simple tranche table (months 1-6) showing committed tokens, expected effective rate, and the condition for each discount?
- We need procurement to see a version of the SOW that ties milestone acceptance to invoice timing.

I've attached a procurement checklist from our side (not attached here) — can you line up a version of the MAP that they can sign off on by next week? Our internal approval window is tight: target decision by 5/28.

Appreciate it,
Jared
CTO, Nimbus Health

> Thanks again for the time today — sharing the MAP draft and SOW shortly.
>
> -Kim

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jared Lin <jared@nimhealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP tranches + SOW draft (v3)
Attachments: Nimbus_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_Draft_20270522.pdf (draft SOW)

Hi Jared — attaching version 3 of the MAP and a clean SOW that ties milestone acceptance to billing windows. Key changes since our call:

- Tranche table (sheet 1): month-by-month committed token floors (months 1-6), staged effective rate, and a clear clause for rollback to list price if acceptance criteria are not met by checkpoint.
- Incentives: 10% onboarding credit applied if Nimbus hits both the integration and security checkpoints by end of month 2; additional 5% discount for sustained commit at month 4.
- Timing & billing: milestone acceptance triggers invoice milestone; payment due net 30 unless procurement requests net-45 for initial PoV.

As requested, I copied Marissa (rev ops) for checklist/approval and included a short comment column in the spreadsheet with legal-viability notes. If procurement wants a firmer SAP account-level SLA, we can add that as an appendix.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement reviews SOW + returns redlines by EOD 5/26
2) We finalize the MAP and internal approvals by 5/27
3) Signoff and DocuSign link to procurement by 5/28 to meet your decision window

If those dates don't work, tell me which ones do and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
km: +1 415-555-0132

From: Procurement <procurement@nimhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jared Lin <jared@nimhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP tranches + SOW draft (v3)

Kimberly — quick comments from procurement below. Forwarding the checklist to Marissa for operational acceptance.

- Net-45 acceptable for initial invoice only if we receive milestone evidence in 7 days; otherwise net-30.
- Need clearer acceptance criteria for "security checkpoint" (we require SOC-2 type evidence or equivalent test report).
- Can you confirm if Redwood is willing to include an uptime SLA for the PoV period (we only need commitment for scheduled maintenance windows)?

We should have a full redline back by EOD 5/26.

Thanks,
Nim Procurement

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: pricing flexibility & credit approach for Nimbus MAP v3

Kim / Ben — looping you both in to confirm concession runway. A few internal notes (not sent to Nimbus yet):

- The 10% onboarding credit at month 2 is fine, but we should cap cumulative credits at 12% for the entire PoV unless we get an uplift commitment (preferred).
- For the additional 5% discount at month 4, suggest we require a 90-day minimum committed velocity window (to avoid immediate stop/start).
- If procurement asks for net-45, we can accept for first invoice only; need approvals to offer net-45 in HubSpot terms. Ben — can you approve that concession and confirm whether finance will tag the first invoice as net-45 exception?

Also attaching an annotated copy of the MAP with comment bubbles on the acceptance evidence (sheet: comments). If approved, I'll push the redline back to Nimbus with suggested SLA wording and the capped credit language.

-Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Internal: pricing flexibility & credit approach for Nimbus MAP v3

Marissa / Kim — good proposal. Approve the following:

- Cap cumulative onboarding credits at 12%.
- Require the 90-day committed velocity window for the month-4 discount.
- First invoice exception to net-45 approved; finance will label it in the invoice metadata and run a 30/45 cashflow alert.

Marissa — please incorporate these notes into the MAP v3 and return to Nimbus procurement with the SLA appendix and a clear acceptance-evidence checklist. Kim, once they confirm the SOC-2-style evidence and net-45 acceptance, proceed to DocuSign.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Finance | Redwood Inference
